nudgeOnCheckpoint.message: Continue the impl — all four suites green at named stages, PINs unmoved, adjacents undisturbed. Write impl-honesty-notes.md incrementally so a mid-flight death still harvests the state.

messageOnSpawn.body: Read your objectiveRef brief IN FULL first — the four contracts are the authorities, the four suites are your acceptance machinery. The craft laws bind (no clocks, additive-only, NUL discipline, generated docs regenerate never hand-edit). Your [attempt:] line verbatim in the notes' first five lines. Never edit the suites — a wrong row is a DECISION_REQUEST, not a suite edit. Verify before you finish: the four targets + the named adjacents.
